posts.meta_description:
56K likes, 853 comments - kubbrasait on April 8, 2025: "“Success is not about being the BEST, it’s about being better than YOU were yesterday.”
-Kubbra Sait

I get asked a lot, “Did you want to be an actor as a child?”
The answer is: no.

Yes, I was full-on drama — a nautanki, a joker, a jester — and I loved the attention. But did I dream of having or doing a job that’s creative, emotional, entertaining and bear the responsibility of being self-employed?
Absolutely not.

I did want to live in Mumbai though — and after a rollercoaster ride (or two), I made it to this city of dreams.

Back then, my only stage experience was in a school drama class. Cut to now: years of being an actor, learning on the job, set after set.
This post feels like a thank you note for the journey so far.

Thank you to my co-actors and directors and every writer who created parts I could sink my teeth into… and immerse a piece of my heart in.

Here’s to the stories we tell — and the stories still to come.

#Gratitude #ActorLife #MumbaiDreaming #OpenBook #KubbraSait #India #Love #Joy #showreel".

721 likes, 14 comments - cosmoindia on October 30, 2026: "Living authentically means living by your inner values rather than external approval or societal expectations. Kubbra Sait (@kubbrasait) learnt this the hard way when she was very young. “I was very badly bullied for over two years in elementary school.” This is when her parents enrolled her in personality development classes where she met a teacher who changed her life. “My formative belief system was completely rewritten and that changed everything. My teacher would ask me, 'why do you get upset when someone calls you names? Are you that name? And if you are not then why are you allowing that to affect you?’” That sense of non-judgement was sown so deep into her being that even years later, if she ever goes off track, Sait always finds her way back. 

Read the interview at the link in bio!

481 likes, 15 comments - cosmoindia on October 30, 2026: "Despite the many projects she has on the go, Kubbra Sait (@kubbrasait) carves out a fortnight every year that’s just for her to push her boundaries physically and mentally. “In the larger scheme of things, a fortnight seems insignificant but it really has changed my life. I do things that I’ve never done before and the learnings I come back with give me the fuel and calm that I need to survive the rest of the year.” She’s scaled Mount Kilimanjaro (Uhuru Peak) in Tanzania, rafted down the Siang in Arunachal Pradesh and gone scuba diving in the Great Barrier Reef in Australia.

Read her full interview at the link in bio!

1,712 likes, 54 comments - cosmoindia on October 30, 2026: "Kubbra Sait (@kubbrasait) was well into her 20s when she realised that living authentically was how she wanted to live. This hasn’t changed in the years since, as she’s moved cities (Bengaluru to Dubai and now Mumbai) and changed professions (marketing to entertainment). On an unseasonably hot October evening when we chatted online, she’s at the members-only section of Mumbai’s Soho House. Dressed in activewear, with not a lick of makeup, she is glowing—but she’s something more, something strong. Even with the publicity machinery around her, she is a unique presence.

Read her full interview at the link in bio!

486 likes, 8 comments - kubbrasait on October 29, 2026: "Art in the present can take its inspiration from art in the past. 🤍

At India Design ID, I met Nishita Kamdar @studionishitakamdar @pod_piecesofdesire whose beautiful swings bring a beloved piece of Indian home life into the present. She calls herself the OG swinger, and honestly, the energy is unmatched. Matteo and I had the best time chatting with her. At one point I wondered if the room was spinning. Nishita said maybe it was my head. 😅

Such a fun conversation about furniture, craft and the way design can transform a space.

@indiadesignid @matteocibic

[India Design ID, Pieces of Desire, Nishita Kamdar, Indian furniture design, handcrafted swings, Indian design, collectible design, interior design]".

199 likes, 10 comments - kubbrasait on October 29, 2026: "I thought I’d visit India Design ID @indiadesignid ONE TIME. I went back for seconds and thirds 😅

Through the lovely, ridiculously energetic Matteo Cibic’s @matteocibic eyes and my own, I found art in nostalgia, culture, heritage and all the things that move us. I even made a friend for life after failing to recognise him at first. What a day. Had so much fun making this little vlog. Hope you have fun watching it too. 🤍

Thank You @aparnabadlani for 2 spectacular days and nights of dreaming after!!!
